answer: A whisper of per-task receipts records who did what, and the mirror of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, reset on any identity-link attempt. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. What survives to the vault is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
